title: Obstruct triangular multidirectional actuator families
statement: For T={U=(v(x2,x3),w(x3),0):mean U=0} and every prescribed force f in T, exact nonlinear equations are w_t=nu partial3^2 w+f2 and v_t=nu(partial2^2+partial3^2)v-w partial2 v+f1; nonlinear advection is already divergence-free. Initial +/-sqrt(2)M e2 cos(2pi x3)/sqrt(1+4pi^2) have an autonomous second-component difference, so one exact smooth endpoint has L2 norm>=M exp(-4pi^2 nu tau)/sqrt(1+4pi^2). Thus ANY actuator family contained in T fails the arbitrary-epsilon common-control assertion, even with several spatial directions/frequencies and genuine nonlinear advection. Global smooth reduced solutions apply to admitted weak realizations. This is not an obstruction to all finite actuator families.
